title: fix(fields): read-only percent and currency faces render through their cells' formatters; a whole currency amount keeps its minor units (objectui#11444)
body:
Fixes #11444

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The read-only percent and currency faces now make the formatting call their table cells make, so a read-only form and the table show one stored value identically. This is the rest of the objectui#11431 family: the `number` member landed in PR objectui#11442, and this extends its shared module `packages/fields/src/widgets/number-format.ts`. There is no second formatter.

**Percent.** `PercentField`'s read-only branch printed `toDisplay(value).toFixed(scale)` plus a literal `%`, with no display locale and no grouping. A `scale: 2` field holding `0.25` read `25.00%` in a `de` form while `PercentCellRenderer` read `25,00 %`. The percent rendering body (`formatPercentBody`, private in the barrel) moves into `number-format.ts` as `formatPercentPoints(displayValue, precision, locale)`. `formatPercent` (the cell) calls it after `percentDisplayValue`; the read-only face calls it with `useDisplayLocale()`, its own `toDisplay` and the width `resolveFieldScale` already answered. The width source and the face's storage reading (a fraction unless `max > 1`) are unchanged.

**Currency.** Triage ruled (comment 5946462862) that the protocol's convention is the declared width, the ISO 4217 minor unit, and retired the objectui#4033 whole-amount trimming in the cell. `formatCurrency` moves into `number-format.ts` (the barrel re-exports it under the same name and signature), loses the trimming, and the read-only face calls it instead of its private `formatAmount`. `currencyDisplayWidth(currency)` is the one width derivation, read by `formatCurrency` and by `CurrencyField`'s `step` and blur rounding.

## Which formatCurrency (mechanism assumption 4, measured)

Two functions are named `formatCurrency`:

- `@object-ui/fields`, the cell's (in the barrel at BASE, in `number-format.ts` now);
- `@object-ui/i18n` (`packages/i18n/src/utils/formatting.ts`, re-exported by `@object-ui/react`), with the signature `(value, options)`.

At BASE neither face reached the i18n one. The cell called the fields `formatCurrency`, the read-only face called its private `formatAmount`, and both rendered through `formatDisplayNumber` from `@object-ui/i18n`. So the root of the drift was those two copies inside `packages/fields` (one trimmed a whole amount, one did not), not `packages/i18n`. Both faces now call the fields one: every by-reference face already calls it, and it derives the width from the resolved currency, where the i18n one leaves both bounds to its caller and defaults its locale to `en` rather than the display locale. `packages/i18n` is not edited.

## formatCurrency callers (each moves with the ruling)

From `git grep -n formatCurrency` over `packages/` and `apps/`, non-test:

| Caller | Kind |
|---|---|
| `CurrencyCellRenderer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) | table cell, and every surface that draws the registered `currency` cell through `getCellRenderer` (grid rows, the detail panel's `DetailSection`, `HeaderHighlight`, `RelatedList`, `RecordMetaFooter`) |
| `CurrencyField` read-only branch (`packages/fields/src/widgets/CurrencyField.tsx`) | read-only form face (new caller here) |
| `formatSummaryLabel` currency arm (`packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts`) | grid column-summary footer (an aggregate) |
| `renderFieldValue` (`packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`) | the record drawer for inline rows with no object: an untyped key named like an amount (a name-inferred fallback) |
| currency face of `ObjectMetricWidget` (`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectMetricWidget.tsx`) | dashboard metric tile (an aggregate), when a currency code resolves |
| `renderFieldValue` (`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/recordFields.tsx`) | dashboard table widget cell and record detail drawer value, for a currency-symbol `format` |
| tooltip value formatter (`packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`) | gantt tooltip amount row |

No export path calls it, and `apps/` has no caller.

**Detail panel (assumption 5).** `plugin-detail` draws a currency or percent value through `getCellRenderer` (`DetailSection`, `HeaderHighlight`, `RecordMetaFooter`, `RelatedList`), so it shows the cell's text and moves with the currency ruling. Its summary chip calls `formatPercent`, whose output is unchanged. `InlineFieldInput` mounts `CurrencyField` / `PercentField` in edit mode only, so the read-only faces changed here are not on its path.

## Outside the claim's file surface (declared, one separate commit)

Commit `9eacbff71` edits `plugin-grid` and `plugin-dashboard`, outside the claim's surface (`packages/fields`). It is a separate commit so the seat can judge it on its own. The measured need: after the fields commit, 14 tests in 7 files outside `packages/fields` went red, every one a pin of the retired trimming, and one source restatement no longer matched the cell.

- `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx` restated the cell's no-currency width as a numeral pattern (`'0,0'` for a whole amount). Its pin compares the tile against the cell, so it went red. It now restates `'0,0.00'`.
- Comments in `useColumnSummary.ts` and `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx` that said a whole amount drops its fraction.
- Pins moved on purpose, each citing the ruling: `useColumnSummary.test.tsx`, `gridFixedCurrency-10354`, `useColumnSummary.currencyMinorUnit-10221`, `useColumnSummary.currencyMode-10422`, `ObjectMetricWidget.currencyMinorUnit-10221`, `ObjectMetricWidget.currencyMode-10422`, `recordFields.currencyConfig-10463`.

No open PR touches these files (a REST read of each open PR's file list). The changeset declares `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` for the tile.

## Pins moved on purpose (triage comment 5946462862)

In `packages/fields/src/__tests__/`:

- `formatCurrency.centsDigit.test.tsx`: the whole-amount control (`$1,234`, `$5,000,000`, `$0`) now carries `.00`, and the no-currency whole row reads `5,000,000.00`. It stays a control: a range `[0, 2]` would trim them again, which the currency ablation below shows.
- `formatCurrency.minorUnits.test.tsx`: the whole-amount control rows (USD, EUR, KWD, BHD) now read at the currency's width; the JPY row is unchanged (width 0); the no-currency whole row reads `5,000,000.00`. Header item 2 rewritten to say why.
- `NumberCellRenderer.grouping.test.tsx`: three whole-amount currency controls gain `.00` / `,00`; grouping, their subject, is unchanged.
- `cellRenderers.fabricatedValue-8490.test.tsx`: a real stored 0 in a no-currency cell prints `0.00`.

No control half was deleted. Comment-only: `CurrencyField.symbol.test.tsx` and `currency.ts` now name `formatCurrency` where they named the removed `formatAmount`.

Pending changesets: `10221-currency-decimals-iso-minor-unit.md` promised the trimming on the footer and the tile, and `grid-summary-footer-tenant-locale-9294.md` gives the trimming as a property of `formatCurrency`. Each gets an appended dated note. `10422-currency-mode-dynamic-tenant-default.md` writes `$3,456` as what a dynamic field should show; its subject is the currency symbol, so it is left as written.

## Measured (real SchemaRenderer, real form renderer, real fields registration)

New pin `packages/fields/src/__tests__/PercentCurrencyField.readonlyDisplay-11444.test.tsx`. The directions and the count were written into its header before the first run.

- BASE `5988b6b53` (pin only): `Tests 13 failed | 14 passed (27)`, predicted 13 and 14. Red: the `de` percent row (`25.00%` against `25,00 %`); the USD whole row (cell `$3,456` against `$3,456.00`); the parity rows wherever the locale, the grouping (`1234.5%` against `1,234.5%` in `en`) or a whole amount (USD, KWD, no currency) changes the text. Green: the `en` percent and `3456.5` controls, and every JPY row.
- After: `Tests 27 passed (27)`.

## Ablations (one-off, through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on the committed fix)

- Percent half: the read-only call replaced by `toDisplay(value).toFixed(scale)` plus `%` (anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `a94b717cbe10` to `7dc96759a4a8`). Predicted 6 red; observed `Tests 6 failed | 21 passed (27)`: the `de` row, the `en` four-digit row and four `de` parity rows. Restore proven: blob equal to the HEAD blob `a94b717cbe10`, and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Currency half: the whole-amount trim re-inserted in `formatCurrency` (blob `c6df2082065c` to `2b22d8777e9e`), run over the new pin and the two moved `formatCurrency` pins. Predicted 11 red; observed `Tests 11 failed | 62 passed (73)`: the new pin's USD whole row, 6 `minorUnits` rows and 4 `centsDigit` rows. The parity rows stay green, as predicted: with the trim back both faces trim together, so the literal row is what catches it. Restore proven: blob equal to the HEAD blob `c6df2082065c`, and `git diff HEAD` empty.

Both went the expected direction (red). No `dist` leg: the pin imports the widgets and the barrel by relative path.

## Tests and gates

The source bytes were measured at `9eacbff71`. The final commit `45cff65c0` adds only a dated note to one `.changeset` file, and the gates below were re-run at `45cff65c0`.

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over every `packages/fields` test file (232), in three chunks: `75 passed | 1 skipped (76)`, `80 passed (80)`, `76 passed (76)` files; `1613 passed | 7 skipped`, `1279 passed`, `706 passed` tests. One whole-package run hit a 570s timeout on the shared box (exit 124) and was re-run in chunks.
- Every test outside `packages/fields` that mentions currency or percent, in the packages that can reach the fields formatters (159 files, two batches): `Test Files 74 passed (74)`, `Tests 929 passed (929)`; and `Test Files 85 passed (85)`, `Tests 1644 passed (1644)`. This covers the brief's plugin-grid, plugin-detail and apps/console set.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check`, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/fields^...'`: exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` shows the new pin and `number-format.ts` in the test program and the four changed source files in the build program.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: OK, 20 source files of 3 released packages and 1 changeset. `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: OK. `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: report-only, 5 pending changesets name a touched file; each paragraph read, and none is about what this change moves. `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`: report-only, the two dated notes, intended.
- eslint over the 20 changed TS files, a narrowed run: 0 errors. Population: `--print-config` for each file shows the root config with no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move a verdict on a file it did not touch. Counts from `--format json`: 20 files, 0 errors. Warnings per file are identical to BASE through `--stdin` (for example `index.tsx` 137 and 137, `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx` 11 and 11; the two new files 0).
- NOT MEASURED: `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, reason: their diff is one string literal and comments; declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Percent scaling stays per face, measured. The read-only face reads a value as a fraction unless the field declares `max > 1` (the rule `percentScaleOf` in `@objectstack/spec` states and the edit input writes by); the cell uses `percentDisplayValue`, which infers from the value's magnitude. They agree on a fraction-stored value strictly between -1 and 1 and on a whole-stored value outside that range. They part elsewhere: a fraction-stored `1` reads `100%` in the form and `1%` in the cell, `1.5` with `scale: 1` reads `150.0%` against `1.5%`, and a `max: 100` field holding `0.5` reads `0.5%` against `50.0%`. Reported to the seat in the dev report, not changed here.
- Docs: `content/docs/fields/currency.mdx` and `percent.mdx` say nothing this makes false. A line saying the table cell now shows a whole amount at the currency's width could be added by a docs pass, outside this surface.
- `@object-ui/i18n` still exports its own `formatCurrency` with no first-party caller; noted, not changed.
- The changeset is `patch`, as the dispatch set it. The family's earlier entries that moved visible currency output (objectui#10221, objectui#10276) were `minor`; the seat may want to align it.
